message.subject: Pausing my plan while I'm in Italy
message.body:
Hi team,

Exciting news, I'm off to Italy for two months! My sister is getting married in Puglia and we've decided to make a proper trip of it, so I'll be gone from early October until early December.

Could you please pause my plan for October and November so nothing turns up at the flat while I'm gone? I don't want a parcel sitting at the depot for weeks. I think my next payment is due on 2 October, so hopefully I've caught it in time.

Then I'd like everything to start up again when I'm back in December. Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Grazie mille!
Sofia

policy.label: Policy P6.1: Pausing, cancelling or changing a plan
policy.text:
Pausing. A plan can be paused for 1 to 3 months at a time. Ask at least 3 days before the next billing date for the pause to apply to that order. With less notice, we can still stop the order and refund it if it has not been dispensed. A paused plan can restart early at any time: the first order goes out on the restart date, which becomes the new billing date. Plans are monthly; there is no two-monthly option, but a pause can space orders out.

Cancelling. A plan can be cancelled at any time with no fee. With at least 3 days' notice before the billing date there are no further charges. Orders that have already been dispatched cannot be recalled.

Changing products. Adding, removing or swapping a product needs a clinician's approval. Once approved, the change and any new price apply from the next billing date.

Stop sending. If a patient says to stop sending, stop, or not send anything more, put every order that has not been dispatched on hold straight away, before replying. Then ask whether they want to pause or cancel. The hold stays until the patient confirms. Reply within 1 business day. If the reason is a health concern, the message goes to a clinician (see clinical questions).

policy.label: Policy P4.3: Address changes, signatures and missed deliveries
policy.text:
Address changes. A patient can change their address in their account or by message, after an identity check (see account access). A change made before dispatch applies to that order. After dispatch, we can ask Courierline to redirect the parcel, which takes about 1 business day and is not guaranteed. Work addresses are fine.

Signatures. Prescription medicines need a signature, so we cannot deliver to parcel lockers or PO boxes, and we cannot authorise leaving a parcel at the door. The outer packaging is plain (see product questions), but it is handed to whoever signs, so patients should choose a delivery address they are comfortable with.

Missed deliveries. If nobody is home, Courierline leaves a card and holds the parcel at the local depot for 5 business days. The patient can book a free redelivery or collect it with photo ID using the tracking link. After 5 business days the parcel goes back to the pharmacy, and sending it again carries the one-off shipping fee.

policy.label: Policy P4.2: Late, lost, damaged or wrong orders
policy.text:
Late orders. 1 business day past the ETA: share the tracking and reassure the patient. 2 business days past the ETA: open a trace with Courierline, which takes up to 3 business days, and tell the patient we have done it. 5 business days past the ETA, or when Courierline confirms the parcel is lost: reship at no cost. Every reship of a prescription medicine needs pharmacist sign-off, usually the same business day, and is dispatched within 1 business day of sign-off.

Marked delivered but not received: ask the patient to check safe spots and with neighbours, and open a trace straight away. If the parcel is not found within 3 business days, reship at no cost.

Damaged or leaking: ask for a photo within 7 days of delivery and ask the patient not to use the damaged item. After pharmacist sign-off we reship at no cost. The damaged item does not need to come back; any pharmacy can dispose of it safely.

Wrong item: ask the patient not to use it. A pharmacist contacts them within 1 business day and the right item is reshipped at no cost.

Never promise a delivery date beyond the ETA shown on the order.

Hi [FIRST_NAME],

Yes, your plan can be paused while you are away, as a plan can be paused for 1 to 3 months at a time [3]. The team will look into setting up the pause for October and November.

Your next billing date is 2 October 2026 [1]. A pause applies to that order when it is requested at least 3 days before the billing date [3]. The team will confirm that your pause covers that order.

For December, the team will check and confirm the date your plan starts up again. If you come home sooner, a paused plan can restart early at any time. The first order goes out on the restart date, which becomes your new billing date [3].

I hope the wedding is wonderful. The team will be in touch to confirm your pause and restart date.

Kind regards,
[AGENT_NAME]
